{{Top|leg}}
The '''Council of 127''' was a ruling body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garban]] and of the [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The council was under the leadership of the [[Premiere (Jenet)|Premiere]], the leader of the Jenets. The members of the Council of 127 were chosen by a byzantine process that was difficult for non-Jenets to comprehend. Nevertheless, the council members were easily distinguished from the populace at large because their names were changed to reflect their status.<ref name="GG4b ">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>
